The unchanged sameGatewayEndpoint top-level facade is reused with declaration and class provenance recorded. No stubbed gateway behavior.

publication.merge_condition: All applicable current-head checks and effective GitHub rules must pass.

changes: Moonshine silence uses the existing bounded retry policy; fatal recognition, memory and cleanup failures dominate silence and preserve repair actions.
Voice incidents preserve a single fixed failure code and safe original exception evidence across both local Moonshine and Android fallback recognition.
Passive missing Gateway command receipts use isolated exponential backoff; explicit reconnect and restored-work review still read live and never replay an unknown command.
Gateway route diagnostics distinguish command, message, conversation, capability and catalog reads.
Approved public reports retain application-owned failure codes and safe frames without raw messages, endpoint identifiers or private-session content.
Unicode-heavy fallback reports retain app version, commit, report identity and error metadata inside the encoded URL budget.

Verified no-dispatch rejection proofs settle queue leases without waiting for nonexistent output; malformed or unrelated receipts, accepted races, unrepresented older jobs and uncertain restored commands remain fenced. Explicit restore checks each command live and preserves earlier accepted output delivery.
